newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Savings Bank has 10.4 bln lev 9 mth profi.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Savings Bank has 10.4 bln lev 9 mth profi.

text.p: The State Savings Bank (SSB), Bulgaria's largest savings institution, reported 10.427 billion levs ($43.4 million) pretax profit for the first nine months of the year, an SSB statement said.
The SSB had 10.385 billion levs pretax profit for the whole of 1995. Comparative figures for the first nine months of last year were not available.
The SSB is the largest buyer of treasury issues and along with the central bank it is also the largest creditor to Bulgaria's commercial banks.

Under a Bulgarian deposit guarantee law the SSB repays lev deposits of companies and individuals in local banks against which the central bank has filed insolvency suits. The SSB can also use these bonds as collateral against borrowing from the BNB.
"The SSB has repaid around 12 billion levs as compensation for deposits in five banks placed in receivership," SSB director Bistra Dimitrova.
The central bank has placed nine more banks under special supervision in a bid to stave off their collapse.
